purpose: New conditional calibration of corrected resolved inference and native rectilinear photometry, with preserved control failures and explicit limits on classification.
relation_to_old_studies: An independent experiment using current released model contracts. It neither continues nor bypasses the unresolved 2025 exact-Student native point/recovery protocol, and it does not relabel the historical64-draw campaign.
truth_separation: Truth is stored separately from fit inputs; fit calls receive no generating parameters or truth initializations. This is computational separation, not external human blinding or external registration.

resolved_design.source_offsets_over_theta: (0.65+0.12*sin(i),0.55+0.07*cos(0.7*i)); free source position at every row
resolved_design.covariance: Known hypothetical dense covariance: sigma=(0.003theta)*4,0.01 in log flux,0.005*(4GM/c^3) in delay seconds; same-axis image correlation0.25; log-flux/delay correlation0.2; cross-epoch correlation0.2^abs(i-j)
resolved_design.qualification: Supplied hypothetical resolved measurements/distances/covariance for conditional algorithm tests, not manufactured measurements of any actual unresolved event or an instrument forecast.

photometric_cadence_selection.rule: First identifier in each of the two strata of the already frozen100-event selection; choice ignores measured brightness, new fit outcomes and follow-up ranking.
photometric_cadence_selection.time: Preserve every native relative HJD time and UNSPECIFIED underlying clock. No precision parallax or angular positions inferred.
photometric_cadence_selection.errors: Condition on unchanged supplied optimized magnitude errors; no second correction and no native covariance fabrication. Gaussian independence is the matching signal experiment's explicit generating assumption.

photometric_families.noise: independent Gaussian with fixed parent marginal sigma

photometric_families.definition: same point lens, two unresolved sources:0.7A(t0,tE,u0)+0.3A(t0+1.2tE,tE,0.5), total source fraction0.65

photometric_families.noise: sigma*(sqrt(0.5)*independent Normal+sqrt(0.5)*stationary Gaussian OU),tau30days, stable time order, no season reset

seeds.repeat_policy: Reproduce generated input twice at identical key; count as one realization. No redraw, clipping, replacement or outcome-dependent seed changes.

photometry_profile.values: one fixed generating tE per matching-PSPL case

intervals.other_local_parameters: additive local Normal, no reduced-chi-square rescaling
intervals.core_coverage: finite solved physically admitted estimator intervals before goodness-of-fit selection; unavailable/generation/solver failures count as misses
intervals.deployed_joint_success: separately report usable-and-covered after existing goodness screen; do not test this selected joint probability against0.95
intervals.photometric_profile: Generating tE belongs to the delta-chi-square<=chi2_1(0.95) interior reference set; not an endpoint estimate. Unresolved/boundary/reference-failure ordinates remain unavailable and count conservatively as misses.
intervals.coverage_scope: Conditional on each fixed truth/cadence/noise block; not universal, actual-object or nonregular coverage certification.

statistics.binomial_uncertainty: exact95percent intervals separately per block; report planned/attempted/failed/unavailable/covered and completion bounds
statistics.gross_local_miscalibration: two-sided exact binomial test of0.95, only the20 resolved+6 photometric local-parameter tests plus2 profile-truth tests; Bonferroni alpha0.01/28; report all findings, never tune intervals or discard runs
statistics.screen_rates: Keep constant/variable nonrejection and binary/correlation misspecification nonrejection separate. They are not a calibrated BH false-positive rate.
statistics.mass_comparator: resolved95percent lower mass bound above3solar masses is a synthetic optical-mass comparator only; not a universal neutron-star limit or BH identity
statistics.unimplemented_classifier: BH classifier not evaluated, BH false-positive and false-negative rates unavailable; zero flags cannot prove specificity.

budgets.rule: No automatic retries. Preserve generation/fit/profile/serialization failures; stop on source change, global wall/storage exhaustion or input corruption. Enumerate every remaining planned case as not attempted. A stopped campaign is NOT_COMPLETED, never a successful coverage study.

outputs: full prospective freeze with exact protocol/driver/module/kernel/runtime/raw-parent pins
original cadence parents and all generated input hashes before fit
all generated inputs and full fit outcomes in deterministic gzip JSON
one summary row per planned fit with failures and not-attempted rows
scientific_boundaries: Entirely synthetic calibration, not a new real-object interpretation or mass recovery
One Einstein/GHY optical exterior interpreted as BHSM surface topography, counted once
The authentic known-system benchmark remains independent and requires its own calibrated observation/likelihood admission
No changes to frozenRC6, raw observations or historical campaigns
